profile_text.body:
Greylock Partners is a venture capital firm based in Menlo Park, California, founded in 1965. On its website the firm describes itself as a leading venture capital firm based in Silicon Valley and as an early partner to teams building companies that matter. It says each Greylock partner makes only one or two new investments a year because the work demands depth, and that the firm brings its full attention, network, and resources to every partnership. The site also quotes a line about a Greylock partner aspiring to win the Oscar for the best supporting actor, a reputation it says must be earned every day.

The company's own materials do not name specific AI products or portfolio companies, and no products are tracked for it here. Its recorded activity is investment rather than product building.

Among the facts held about the firm, it is recorded as a for-profit investor organization with headquarters in Menlo Park, California, United States. No lawsuits are listed for it, and no MCP servers are recorded. Its recorded law exposure is in California, with a count of 281.
